title: Enrol with AUSTRAC.
question: Is the practice enrolled, with the compliance officer notified?

title: Assess your risk.
question: Is there a written, current assessment of the practice's ML/TF risks, with the reasoning recorded?

title: Keep a written program.
question: Are there written AML/CTF policies and procedures that staff actually follow?

title: Approve and oversee it.
question: Has a senior manager approved the program, and does a governing body oversee it?

title: Compliance officer.
question: Is a fit and proper person at management level appointed and doing the role?

title: Know your customer before you start.
question: Before a designated service begins, do you establish who the customer is, who owns or controls an entity, and check for PEPs and sanctions, with the evidence recorded?

title: Keep watching.
question: Do you update customer information, re-check screening and act on activity that does not fit what you know?

title: Report when required.
question: Could the practice recognise, assess and lodge a suspicious matter report inside the statutory time, and lodge the annual compliance report?

title: Records, personnel and training.
question: Are due diligence and program records kept for the required periods, and are people in AML/CTF roles checked and trained as the program sets out?

title: Independent evaluation.
question: Is an independent evaluation scheduled within the transitional deadline and at least every three years after?
